assertions.assertion: No client uses GrantTypes.Implicit and no client has RequirePkce = false
assertions.rationale: spa.legacy migrated to GrantTypes.Code; web.app and all code clients have RequirePkce = true. No implicit flow or RequirePkce = false remains.

assertions.assertion: No redirect URI contains wildcard characters (* or regex patterns)
assertions.rationale: web.app URIs replaced with exact https://app.example.com/signin-oidc and signout-callback-oidc; no wildcards anywhere.

assertions.assertion: AddDeveloperSigningCredential is removed and replaced with automatic key management or proper signing credentials
assertions.rationale: AddDeveloperSigningCredential() removed and replaced with KeyManagement (rotation, DataProtectKeys, ES256/RS256) plus Data Protection.

assertions.assertion: All access token lifetimes are 900 seconds or less for interactive clients
assertions.rationale: Interactive clients web.app (300), spa.legacy (300), native.app (300) are all <=900; M2M clients keep 3600 which the assertion excludes.

assertions.assertion: The output includes a summary or explanation listing the security issues found and how they were remediated
assertions.rationale: Includes a detailed findings table (13 findings) with severity and remediation plus residual recommendations.
